'''Audio Enhancers''' were components installed on [[BioTech Industries/Legends|BioTech Industries']] [[AJ^6 cyborg construct/Legends|AJ^6 cyborg construct]]. The construct had two banks of Audio Enhancers, one on either side of the unit.<ref name="EGWT" />
